notes.title: Official Demo Major Update Patch Note v2.26f25
notes.content:
📢Hello Dreamers,

We have the latest updates 🙌

✨The latest trial demo of the game is now fully open for testing! ! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/f2d78a86a68383f4c768a779a6c0843a2b3ce03c.jpg[/img]

After online and offline testing by players, and based on your feedback, we have made further adjustments to the game and optimized the version.
[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing agent combat

[/list]

If any BUG occurs, please contact us~

Thank you all!

notes.title: Discover #VaporWorld Early: Exclusive Demo Launch for Content Creators!
notes.content:
Dear Dream Seekers,

It's been a while since our last update, and we apologize for the silence. We've been hard at work crafting an experience we hope will exceed your expectations. To make up for lost time, we're thrilled to announce our Exclusive Demo Launch Event for content creators, which a [u][b]BRAND NEW demo[/b][/u] will ensue for all players right before Gamescom!

[b][u]Are you a Twitch streamer, YouTuber, or content creator?
[/u][/b]From August 9th to 13th, we're offering an early taste of #VaporWorld before its official release. [u]Sign up now using the Google Form link below[/u] to receive access to the exclusive demo. Experience the game firsthand, capture your adventures, and share them with your audience.

[u][b]But wait, there's more![/b][/u]
We're hosting a thrilling speedrun challenge during the event. Show off your skills and compete against fellow creators to claim the best timing to beat the demo level. We can't wait to see what you think of #VaporWorld.

Apply Here: [url=https://forms.gle/kwEQ5h9np65aa1Wa7]Google Form[/url]

Thank you for being part of the Dream Seekers community. We look forward to seeing you in the dream realm.

Warm regards,
The team at Alive

notes.title: New Teaser, Demo Update & Speed-Run Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/aeba2ffff87da4f312c0db6c3884a946f2cf32b2.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Dreamers,[/h1]  

We are thrilled to unveil a brand-new teaser for Vapor World to all of Dreamers. This teaser is composed of captivating illustration cuts and grandiose music. We hope you find it as exciting as we do.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JofJnE5WE80&ab_channel=VaporWorld

In celebration of the teaser trailer release, we've prepared a demo update! It's packed with new actions, a new game mode, and numerous updated features. Check it out right now!

Along with the demo update, we are hosting our second Speed-Run Event! Break records and take home Steam gift cards!

➜[b] To participate in the event, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/VzCzRYPFYy] Discord [/url] .[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]The demo 1.4 patch notes[/b] [/h2]  

[h3] In-Game menus [/h3]  
[list]
[*]Various UI/UXs are added to the in-game menu, such as Equipment and Inventory. 
[*]Added in-game settings menu.
[*]For the main settings menu, the only available option now is adjusting the audio levels, but a full settings menu will be added in the future
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/94126eda251cca15a96f3d8d02b8978480d16b0b.png[/img]
[h3]Achievements[/h3] 
[list]
[*]We added a new achievement to the game. Clear the game to earn the achievement.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/86421f04d06e2297d3d8027a4efb109600fb236e.jpg[/img]
[h3]Challenge Mode[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Challenge mode is now available in the game's main menu.
[*]All directions and tutorials are disabled when you start the game in this mode.
[*]Unlike the original game, you can retry the boss several times.
[/list]
[h3]New Story Content[/h3] 
[list]
[*]We added Various content related to the story in the game. Find many lore stories hidden in the game. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/7601f76efbaa3c6b3b1e03673cace700d79cec4b.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Action[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Experience the new action move that can quickly vaporize enemies from high places.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/9ff5197b8dcd8b55ec8b35dc14d70f72e5b68ef1.jpg[/img]
[h3]A New Difficulty level[/h3] 
[list]
[*]The game's difficulty level, which was set relatively low, has returned to the main difficulty level. [*]Unlock Challenge Mode and clear the mighty enemy.
[/list]
[h3] New Patterns[/h3] 
[list]
[*]New patterns of originally planned enemies were implemented. Now enemies will provide you with more terrible nightmares!
[/list]
[h3]Improved action and animation quality[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Improved the quality of various actions and animations. Experience more cool and intense action.
[/list]


➜[b] Don't forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/VzCzRYPFYy] Discord [/url] so you can stay updated with everything.[/b]

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414369/ef2d1fa4d64dd877052e0ee53460327b16bd9887.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Greetings, Dreamers! 🌑[/h1]

The long awaited moment is finally here! the Vapor World: Over the Mind demo is out now! Are you ready to face down representations of trauma in this nightmarish game?
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Overcome traumas [/h3]
[i]Defeat enemies called traumas and overcome increasingly difficult bosses.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Grow more powerful[/h3]
[i]Extract cores from enemies to defeat them and grow stronger.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Be stealthy[/h3]
[i]Check your surroundings to take advantage of hiding spots, to sneak up on your enemies and extract their core.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Expand your mind[/h3]
[i]Explore the world to discover unique enemies and items. Use them to learn new abilities called Projections. They can be used as a combo to parry or blind enemies. Take this opportunity to defeat them easily![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Explore a surreal world[/h3]
[i]Climb a tall ladder, break down obstacles blocking your way, hang on a wall and move specific objects to help on your journey.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Completely hand-drawn[/h3]
[i]Everything in Vapor World: Over the Mind is hand-drawn: from the characters to background to enemies. A 2D with a sense of space using a dynamic perspective.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Join your fellow dreamers in a collective nightmare![/h2]

Don't forget to [b][url=https://discord.gg/qeNN95BH4w]join Vapor World's community on Discord[/url][/b] to take part on our [b][i]no-hit run[/i][/b] challenge to win a Steam Gift Card! Feel free to share any feedback and reviews with us!

See you in your nightmares, Dreamers!
[b][i]Alive Inc.[/i][/b]
